proposal.reason: Main change is a new host one-sided RMA Put/Signal/WaitSignal execution path implemented through CE streams, batched mem-ops, signal/ack synchronization, and CE-side task launch/finalization (copy-engine). It also adds a new RMA task type and planner/launch integration, including graph-capture-aware scheduling and plan cleanup (enqueue). Additional substantive changes adjust symmetric-window/LSA offset semantics and eligibility checks used by RMA and related CE paths, including window validation constraints and flat-address handling updates (symmetric).
